hero.title: GeoAttendance
hero.subtitle: Location-based attendance
hero.text: The GeoAttendance application lets employees check in and out daily within a specific geofence around the organization’s working areas, using their mobile phone. It is designed to improve the overall employee experience, resulting in better time management and increased productivity.

sections.title: Solution features
bullets: Capture employee attendance from any location, at any given time
Easily integrated with internal modules such as HR and Payroll

sections.title: How it works
paragraphs: The application lets employees check in and out within a very specific geofence around the organization’s working areas, all from their phone.
